https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/sigmoid.desc:
Sigmoid Analytics is a fast-growing data and analytics company that partners with global enterprises to deliver real-time business insights. As part of the expansion of our Finance & Accounting team, we are looking for Semi-Qualified Chartered Accountants (CA Inter cleared) who are eager to gain hands-on experience in core finance functions. 
Location 
 Sigmoid Analytics 
2nd Floor, Tower-2, SJR I PARK
Road Number 9, EPIP Zone, Whitefield
Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560066 
Duration 
6-month engagement 
Opportunity for conversion to a full-time role based on performance 
Eligibility Criteria 
Who Can Apply? 
Semi-Qualified CA ( CA Inter cleared – one or both groups) 
Currently pursuing CA internship or articleship 
Aspiring to complete CA qualification in the future 
Roles & Responsibilities 
Handle day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities 
Assist with month-end closing processes and financial reporting 
Prepare and file GST returns 
Calculate and deduct TDS as per applicable regulations 
Prepare and file TDS returns 
Support statutory, internal, and tax audits 
Perform ledger reconciliations and account reviews 
Ensure compliance with accounting standards and taxation regulations 
Required Skills & Qualifications 
Educational Qualification 
Semi-Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA Inter) 
Technical Skills 
Experience or exposure to audit, core accounting, compliance, and taxation 
Working knowledge of GST, TDS, payroll processing, and statutory filings 
Proficiency in:
MS Excel 
MS Word 
Microsoft PowerPoint 
Familiarity with accounting software such as:
Tally 
SAP 
Zoho Books 
QuickBooks 
Soft Skills 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
Good written and verbal communication skills 
High attention to detail and accuracy 
Responsible, proactive, and professional attitude 
Why Join Sigmoid? 
Work with a dynamic and fast-paced finance team 
Gain practical corporate experience in accounting, taxation, and compliance 
Learn from experienced finance professionals and industry experts 
Potential opportunity for a full-time role based on performance 
Exposure to a technology-driven and high-growth organization

 By submitting your application, you consent to being contacted by our Talent Acquisition team via phone call, email, SMS, WhatsApp, or other communication channels regarding your application and relevant career opportunities.
